SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. S. S. U. REGISTRATION,
No. S. B. D. 8/20.
Date May 18 19
at 78 - 5 - 31.

Subject (in full) Transfer of "Communism" from S.1 to S.2.

Made by ______ and ______ Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

In accordance with your instructions regarding the
transfer of "Communism" from S.1 to S.2, I have to state that
arrangements are now complete whereby the change may be
effected at any moment and in this connection your further
instructions are awaited.

The following is a brief outline of the arrangements
made.

Personnel to be transferred to S.2:
D.S. Golder
D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa
C.D.S.96 Tong Hai-lin
Clerk Liao Tsong-jien.

This will bring the staff of S.2 to the following strength:
1 Foreign D.S.I.
3 Foreign Det. Sgts.
1 Foreign D.P.S.
1 Japanese Det. Sgt.
1 Chinese Det. Inspector.
2 Chinese Clerks
1 Chinese Det. Sgt.
1 Chinese Det. Constable - A total of 11.

Equipment to be transferred to S.2:
1 Desk ) For D.S. Golder
1 Chair )
1 Desk ) For D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa
1 Chair )

A portion of the filing cabinet containing records of
Communistic suspects together with other records re
handbills and literature.

G. 20,000-7-30

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

File No. ______

S.1. __________ Station,

REPORT
-2-
Date May 16, 19 31

Subject (in full) _________________________________________________________

Made by ________________________ Forwarded by ________________________

（批：This must lie no decrease in the surveillance over labour and political matters. JPS）

In connection with the various regular Chinese
detectives and agents attached to S.1. I attach a list of
their respective duties from which it will be seen that the
transfer of any of them will necessitate a redistribution of
their duties and a subsequent decrease of surveillance of
labour and political matters.

In addition to the above Chinese detectives and agents
there are also 3 secret agents attached to S.1. whose duties
are divided as follows:-

1 man for the detection of communism and labour unrest
in the Western District
1 man for the detection of communism and labour unrest
in the Eastern District
1 man for the detection of communism in the Settlement -
a more or less free hand.

（批：Until other arrangements are made, these men should give attention to labour appt present cases &ct information coming from any source and instructions from them will pass through the Special Branch of S.2. JPS）

These men are available for transfer but some
arrangements will have to be arrived at whereby any information
re: labour movements would be communicated to S.1.

I also record for your consideration that S.1.
should complete all communistic files and cases in their
possession which would give S.2. a clean start.

（批：O.K. JPS）

The execution of warrants and other Court Orders
will, I take it, be executed by the staff of S.2 and the Duty
Roster of Officers of the Special Branch available after
office hours will stand as it is.

（批：Yes JPS）

It will also be necessary in view of approaching
anniversaries during the present month for some definite
arrangement to be arrived at in order to avoid over-lapping
of work between the two Sections.

（批：Until more definite arrangements can be made all papers dealing with communism matters must pass through the senior officer of S.I. who will have authority to direct S.2 to make investigations re such matters. JPS）

communist matters,
including statistics of arrests.
The yearly report of S.2 should
cover all communist matters.
Mc

Matters for inclusion in the Daily, Monthly and
Yearly reports also calls for attention.

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

C. D. I. Robertson,
Please arrange for the
centralization of Communist work in
S.2 as early as possible. Please
explain to D.P. I. Duncan that all
reports bearing on communist activities
must for the time being pass through
you and that the detectives, agents,
and staff of S.2 must for the time being
undertake any inquiries bearing on
communist activities which you
consider essential in assisting me
to keep the Branch efficient in
regard to communist matters.

Mc
